adoption_note: Named-consumer feasibility correction and finite identifiability result only; no actual biological instance or experiential target admitted.

nodes.statement: Fix one actual-candidate bearer, selected source S, collateral source class Q, named area-3a consumer A, neighbouring/pooled consumer class N, probe epoch, timing relation and admissible alternatives before inference.
nodes.scope: Not complete organization, not a unique subject and not an experience-existence gate.
nodes.quantifier: One same-instance tuple at a time.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Cross-study evidence cannot fill different fields of one instance.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch fixes the local response while changing the writer.

nodes.statement: In the four-cell audit model the target is x_SA, the selected-source-to-area-3a use coordinate; other cells are collateral-to-A and selected/collateral-to-neighbour uses.
nodes.domain: Unrestricted real latent vectors for the theorem; binary vectors for exact witnesses.
nodes.scope: Finite observation contract, not a universal neural dynamics model.
nodes.quantifier: For each declared H and latent x.
nodes.all_premises: Fixed latent ordering and observation matrix.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Nonlinear neural dynamics require a separately declared identifiability analysis.

nodes.statement: For y=Hx on the unrestricted real latent domain, x_SA is identifiable from y iff its coordinate functional lies in the row span of H.
nodes.scope: Standard linear algebra; no mathematical novelty claim.
nodes.quantifier: For every finite H with four latent columns.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not establish that any empirical modality is linear or that H is known.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Gives a precise stop rule for observational twins.

nodes.statement: Pooled, consumer-only, source-only and combined marginal packages retain explicit binary twins with the same observations and opposite x_SA; a direct target row identifies x_SA in the model.
nodes.scope: Insufficiency of declared packages, not impossibility of biological measurement.
nodes.quantifier: All 16 binary latent vectors per package.
nodes.all_premises: A3S:TARGET_COORDINATE and matrices fixed before enumeration.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Adding a valid interaction-selective row can remove the twin.

nodes.statement: Reviewed area-3a studies separately establish field mapping, mixed-input local responses, writable behavioural access, human localization and chronic macaque access; none reviewed here executes source selectivity, consumer selectivity and event binding jointly in one instance.
nodes.domain: The five primary studies in SOURCE_SCOPE.md.
nodes.scope: Targeted literature audit, not exhaustive worldwide impossibility or priority proof.
nodes.quantifier: Each evidence package evaluated on its own instance and direction.
nodes.all_premises: Primary-source claims and cross-study non-composition rule.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: An unreviewed or future crossed experiment may satisfy the contract.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Prevents access, stimulation, localization and natural read from collapsing.

nodes.statement: Stop a selected-source-to-area-3a actual-read inference when source mapping, local consumer event, neighbour control or same-epoch binding is absent; record the first failed premise rather than generalize to impossibility.
nodes.scope: Application inference only; eligibility failure is not absence of experience.
nodes.quantifier: For every evaluated package, all listed premises must hold jointly.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A valid target-selective package passes the finite model but still needs empirical validation.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Bounds further instrument work and returns to the UCT main line.

nodes.statement: If one complete actual P/I/K instance includes the grounded selected-source-to-area-3a use relation, C1 transports that relation to an experience-internal structural counterpart; no agency, ownership, familiar-mineness, conceptual-I or report identity follows without its own bridge.
nodes.domain: One independently admitted actual process and complete signature.
nodes.scope: Positive organizational coordinate inside experience, not a basal gate or exclusive owner.
nodes.quantifier: For each instance satisfying all inherited C1 and relation-grounding premises.
nodes.all_premises: A:C1 plus actual bearer/interval/signature/relation grounding; named-target bridge separate.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Reflex/copy/bypass twins block semantic naming from use evidence alone.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Returns the measurement result to experience–self rather than control engineering.
